profile.web_playable: yes (Google Doodle Pac-Man; official web versions)
profile.onboarding: None; the goal is learned by playing.
profile.controls: Arrow keys or swipe, one direction at a time.
profile.core_loop: Eat dots while avoiding ghosts, with a power pellet to briefly turn the tables.
profile.goals_and_rewards: Clear the maze for score, with fruit bonuses along the way.
profile.difficulty_curve: Speeds up each level and uses a lives system.
profile.game_feel: Tight, instant response with a distinct sound on every dot eaten.
profile.art_and_audio: High-contrast, readable visuals with constant audio feedback.
profile.usability: The goal is instantly clear from the first screen.
profile.accessibility: Requires fast reactions; the ghost chase can feel threatening for younger kids.
profile.ads_and_purchases: None in the classic or Doodle versions.
profile.notes: General knowledge only, not played this session; compare for feedback/pacing, not for the chase-and-threat mechanic itself.
